response.sql: WITH site_metrics AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS site_ratio FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_metrics AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS status_ratio FROM site_metrics GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT sm.insurstat, AVG(sm.site_ratio) AS above_average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS above_average_site_count, SUM(sm.mesh_count) AS above_average_mesh_count, AVG(sm.site_ratio - st.status_ratio) AS average_excess_ratio FROM site_metrics AS sm JOIN status_metrics AS st ON st.insurstat = sm.insurstat WHERE sm.site_ratio > st.status_ratio GROUP BY sm.insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A zero geometric accuracy cannot form a ratio and is excluded from the ratio averages. Mesh counts include all matched mesh records.
